imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts. The dress-boot guide uses three accurate category text links; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product image is required.

searchConsole.signal: Four homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.5, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster
searchConsole.decision: The sample is too small and queryless to support a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore uses one authority expansion and two distinct explorations, with reciprocal links that deepen established consumer-record, footwear and oral-care clusters.
searchConsole.ignored: The four homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant and aggregate average position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or an editorial pivot.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed, sponsored/nofollow category text recommendations appear only on the dress-boot guide. The warranty and mouthwash guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy household warranty and product-registration control file that joins exact product identity, purchase evidence, written coverage, service-contract separation, recall status, claim chronology and documented closure.
authority.cluster: Consumer purchase and ownership authority, with reciprocal paths from major-appliance delivery, heated outerwear, snow-blower and pull-up-bar guides; dress-footwear and oral-care clusters gain reciprocal links as well.
authority.opportunity: One qualified accuracy opportunity was logged for the Federal Trade Commission consumer-education team; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life, Style and Grooming: how to preserve and use warranty evidence after a durable purchase, how to choose a dress boot by use and both-foot fit, and how to select a mouthwash by active ingredient and label. Only the footwear guide is commercial. None follows the weak Search Console sample.

pages.title: Household Warranty and Product Registration System: Proof, Claims and Recalls
